metadata.description: Installable engineering-agent plugins in the Atlas product family.

plugins.name: hapatlas
plugins.description: Workflow-gated HAPAtlas private Alpha control for explicitly selected Carrier HAP projects.

plugins.name: atlas-core
plugins.description: Shared Revit sessions, work identity, inspection, review, recovery and verified delivery.

plugins.name: atlas-family
plugins.description: Create, edit and verify native loadable Revit families. Requires Atlas Core.

plugins.name: atlas-sheets
plugins.description: Create and edit Revit drawing views, sheets and layouts. Requires Atlas Core.

plugins.name: atlas-annotations
plugins.description: Add and edit Revit dimensions, tags, text and drawing annotations. Requires Atlas Core.

plugins.name: atlas-mep
plugins.description: Qualified rigid piping and pipe-only mechanical equipment in owned Revit 2025/2026 projects. Requires Atlas Core.
